text: As for topical CBD, it hasn't been well-studied. There was a short 12-week trial done, where they used a CBD skin gel, and although absorption was good, it didn't work any better than placebo to prevent seizures. The study authors suggested the dosing may have been too low, or that adults with focal epilepsy just don't respond as well as people with the syndromes oral CBD is approved for. The seizures in Dravet and Lennox-Gastaut syndrome are mostly generalized. Generalized are the type people usually have with MDMA & psychedelic overdoses, so topical CBD might do better for those than it did in that trial.
reader: someone with a person who is having, or about to have, a seizure from MDMA or a psychedelic overdose, which is generalized, and who wants to know what can stop it now

sentences.s: As for topical CBD, it hasn't been well-studied.
There was a short 12-week trial done, where they used a CBD skin gel, and although absorption was good, it didn't work any better than placebo to prevent seizures.
The study authors suggested the dosing may have been too low, or that adults with focal epilepsy just don't respond as well as people with the syndromes oral CBD is approved for.
sentences.payoff: the reader learns why the gel's failure doesn't settle it for them: maybe too little got in, and the people tested were adults with focal epilepsy, not the kind of patients CBD is proven in
sentences.follows: answers the question the sentence before leaves: it didn't beat placebo, so why might that be?

sentences.s: The seizures in Dravet and Lennox-Gastaut syndrome are mostly generalized.
sentences.payoff: the reader learns that the proven CBD evidence includes the generalized kind of seizure they are facing, which is what makes it the evidence to go by
sentences.follows: names, of the approved syndromes just mentioned, the two whose seizures are like the reader's, and leads into Joel's sentence on generalized seizures

sentences.s: Generalized are the type people usually have with MDMA & psychedelic overdoses, so topical CBD might do better for those than it did in that trial.
sentences.payoff: the reader learns what all this means for their friend: the failed trial doesn't rule topical CBD out for the generalized seizures MDMA and psychedelic overdoses cause, and may undersell it
sentences.follows: Joel's sentence on which seizures drug overdoses cause, with the conclusion it leads to said, since both fresh readers asked how it bears on the trial

checked.point: the authors suggested it works better for generalized rather than focal seizures
checked.found: O'Brien et al. 2022: "It is also possible cannabidiol doses were too low, time to onset of effect exceeded 12 weeks, or the response to cannabidiol in adults with focal epilepsy is not as robust as seen in patients with Dravet syndrome, Lennox-Gastaut syndrome, or tuberous sclerosis complex"; tuberous sclerosis complex is a condition "with primarily focal seizures" (Thiele et al. 2021), so they didn't say generalized
checked.still_needed: yes: it's what tells the reader the failed trial was in a different kind of patient

checked.point: Dravet and Lennox-Gastaut seizures are mostly generalized
checked.found: the Dravet trial counted convulsive seizures (Devinsky et al. 2017), the Lennox-Gastaut trial drop seizures (Devinsky et al. 2018), and Thiele et al. 2021 sets both syndromes apart from conditions with primarily focal seizures
checked.still_needed: yes: it links the proven evidence to the reader's seizure

checked.point: MDMA and psychedelic overdose seizures are usually generalized
checked.found: "Drug induced seizures are generalized processes" (University of Calgary clinical pharmacology and toxicology pearl, MDMA among the drugs listed); an MDMA case report of a tonic-clonic seizure with low sodium (Elkattawy et al. 2021)
checked.still_needed: yes: it's why the reader should care which syndromes the evidence comes from

checked.point: the authors' third reason, that the effect may take longer than 12 weeks to show
checked.still_needed: no: a slower preventive effect changes nothing for someone having a seizure now

checked.point: topical CBD might do better for those (generalized, drug-caused) seizures than in the trial
checked.found: an extrapolation, said as one ("might"): the authors' own reason was that adults with focal epilepsy may respond less than patients with the approved syndromes, two of which have mostly generalized seizures; no study has tested CBD on drug-caused seizures
checked.still_needed: yes: it is the paragraph's conclusion for this reader (Joel: "we should extrapolate from cbd evidence for that")

placement: where Joel put it: after the cannabis paragraphs, since topical CBD continues the ways of taking CBD they cover, and before the DMSO paragraph, whose "As for DMSO" carries on from P3's list of adjuncts; its "As for topical CBD" points back to CBD taken other ways in the paragraphs before
